title: SCARL: Sequence Confidence-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.40407v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves language-model reasoning by scoring sampled responses with a rule-based verifier and reinforcing those that pass. Where a classifier's training couples predicted probability to labels, nothing ties an RLVR policy's confidence in a response to its reward: aligned training would drive responses with the same advantage toward equal confidence, yet the advantage is blind to confidence. Under this sequence-confidence misalignment, a success the policy barely found earns the same update as one it produces with near certainty, and a confident error is corrected no harder than an exploratory one. We propose SCARL (Sequence Confidence-Aligned Reinforcement Learning), which reshapes, but never re-signs, each advantage with the alignment gap between the response's group-relative confidence and the outcome its advantage certifies, normalized into shares of each class's advantage budget

translated_title: SCARL：序列置信度对齐的强化学习
translated_abstract: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）通过基于规则的验证器对采样响应进行评分，并强化通过验证的响应，从而提升语言模型的推理能力。在分类器的训练中，预测概率与标签是耦合的，但在RLVR中，没有任何机制将策略对某个响应的置信度与其奖励联系起来：对齐的训练本应使具有相同优势的响应趋向于相等的置信度，然而优势机制对置信度是“盲”的。在这种序列置信度失配下，策略好不容易才找到的成功与它几乎确定能产生的成功获得相同的更新幅度，而一个自信的错误与一个探索性的错误受到的纠正力度也没有区别。我们提出SCARL（序列置信度对齐的强化学习），它根据响应的组内相对置信度与其优势所证明的结果之间的对齐差距来重塑（但绝不改变符号）每个优势值，并将其归一化为各类别优势预算中的份额。
tldr: 提出SCARL方法，通过依据响应置信度与验证结果之间的对齐差距重塑优势值，解决了RLVR训练中的序列置信度失配问题，使低置信度的成功获得更大更新、高置信度的错误受到更强纠正。
en_tdlr: SCARL resolves the sequence-confidence misalignment in RLVR by reshaping each advantage according to the alignment gap between a response's confidence and its certified outcome, so barely-found successes receive stronger updates and confident errors get harder corrections.
